selection_reason: APW-01 completed_verified in PR #409 and established the universal-user/contextual-authority model required by automated play. The owner-approved combined APW/APM/CSW sequence selects APM-01 immediately after APW-01.
objective: Define the canonical Automated-Play Authority and Mode Contract: Solo, AutoGM, CozyMode and Connected Cozy terminology; their relationship to Personal/Campaign/Session Context, Live/Asynchronous/Hybrid Cadence and Connected/Offline/Recovering Connectivity; automation-controller identity and delegated authority; start/stop/revoke semantics; auto-resolvable versus mandatory player-choice boundaries; deterministic/domain-owned responsibilities versus optional-AI presentation/proposal responsibilities; provenance; and save/exit/resume behavior.
completion_gate: No AutoGM/Cozy flag, mode, automation controller or optional-AI service can imply global GM authority, bypass an owning domain, fork authoritative state, or silently perform a mandatory human/player choice.
required_design_questions: What is a play mode versus a Context, Cadence, Connectivity state or contextual human role?
What stable identity represents the automation controller and how is it linked to the initiating subject and governed scope?
Which operations may be delegated for automatic resolution and which always require an explicit human/player choice?
How are delegation grant, start, pause, stop, expiry and revocation represented and audited?
Which responsibilities remain deterministic/domain-owned and which may optional AI narrate, converse about, summarize or propose?
How does automated play preserve one ordinary Campaign/Personal state, Event history, provenance, recovery and hidden-information model?
How do save, exit, resume and transition between CozyMode, AutoGM, asynchronous activity and ordinary live play preserve authority and continuity?
preserved_parallel_tracks: APW remains active as an interleaved design program; next APW item is APW-02 after APM-01, CSW-01 and CSW-02.
CSW owner-approved planned track; next item CSW-01 after APM-01.
WP-011 special environment dormant until owner/Mac availability.
next_action: Execute APM-01 as a bounded design/governance tranche using APW-01 as the controlling account/context authority contract and the existing Campaign/Action/Event/permissions/persistence architecture as the owning-domain baseline.
